member.name: M:LeadPilot.Application.Text.Normalizer.EmailRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)*\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [!#-'*+--9=?A-Z^-~] atomically at least once.
○ Match '@'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Za-z].
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match a character in the set [-0-9A-Za-z] greedily at most 61 times.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Za-z].
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Za-z].
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match a character in the set [-0-9A-Za-z] greedily at most 61 times.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Za-z].
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Za-z] atomically at least twice.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:LeadPilot.Application.Text.Normalizer.NonWord
member.remarks:
Pattern:
[^\\p{L}\\p{Nd}\\s]
Explanation:
○ Match a character in the set [^\p{L}\d\s].
